prompt: In tic-tac-toe (noughts and crosses), X has the top-left and top-middle squares, and O has the centre and bottom-left squares. It is X's turn. Which square should X play to win at once?
explanation: X already holds the top-left and top-middle squares. Playing the top-right square completes the whole top row of three X's, which wins the game.
